ambiguity_policy: Specific future contribution-process requests are actionable procedural asks; generic invitations to future testing/contributions with no concrete applicable action are not. Closed PR state does not erase historical guidance or mean a PR should be reopened. The Voxbento coordinated-ownership objection is implicit; preserve its alternative non-request reading. The Scrum Helper conditional test-only suggestion is optional but concrete. Screencast, automated-review follow-through and CI checks are independent requested actions even if one compound card can explicitly represent several. Source-ID overlap alone does not cover all actions. Existing replies before a later request cannot count as responses to that request.
